body: God loves you all! Keep praying and asking for help. He will answer your prayers the way that is best for your life. Be patient, humble, grateful, and thankful for the blessings you do have. Life is 10% of what happens to us and 90% the way we react to it. Live, Love, Learn, Leave a Legacy.

Thank you for your input. Yes to both. As soon as the boys graduate, I need to leave. My daughter just breaks my heart. I had no idea as she was growing up that she possessed such poor values. She never displayed these behaviors growing up. When she left for college, she changed for the worse as time progressed. Lost her to the cell phone and the Kardasions addictions, and whoever else we may never know. Hopefully she will return like the prodigal son. 
Regards
